seoTitle: Olathe Public Schools Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates
seoDescription: Olathe Public Schools begins Aug. 13, 2026, for grades K–5, 6 and 9. See 2026–27 start dates, breaks, half days, last days, school hours and official PDFs.
heroSummary: Olathe Public Schools starts the 2026–27 school year with a half day for grades K–5, 6 and 9 on Thursday, Aug. 13. All K–12 students attend a full day Aug. 14, and Early Childhood starts Aug. 17. Fall Break is Nov. 23–27, Winter Break is Dec. 21–Jan. 1, Spring Break is March 15–19, and grades K–11 finish with a half day May 25.
heroSourceLine: Based on the official OPS 2026–27 district calendar, revised April 1, 2026
heroVerificationSourceText: Reviewed against the current OPS district calendar
heroVerificationComparisonText: The Spanish edition and Elementary Specials calendar were also reviewed
calendarNotes: OPS uses a three-step opening rather than one universal first day: grades K–5, 6 and 9 attend a morning half day August 13; all K–12 grades attend a full day August 14; Early Childhood begins August 17. The annual PDF lists 170 reporting-period days across four quarters. Conference windows run October 12–14 and February 8–10, but buildings provide appointment times; October 14 and February 10 are half days, while October 15 and February 11 are no-student conference days. Winter Break ends January 1, but January 4–5 are professional days, so students resume January 6. March 22 and April 23 are printed both as professional days and possible inclement-weather dates; their status can change if OPS activates them. The Elementary Specials A/B/C/D rotation remains fixed after weather closures. Grade 12 ends May 20 and does not attend the May 25 K–11 half day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Olathe Public Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The opening is grade-specific. Grades K–5, 6 and 9 attend a half day Thursday, August 13, 2026. All K–12 grades attend a full day August 14, and Early Childhood starts August 17.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Olathe students return after Winter Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4–5 are professional days with no students, so students return Wednesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the 2026–27 Olathe conference half days?
calendarFaqs.a: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, and Wednesday, February 10, 2027, are half days for grades K–12 with no Early Childhood. The following Thursdays are conference days with no students.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the possible Olathe weather make-up dates in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: March 22 and April 23, 2027, are scheduled professional days that OPS may use to recover time lost to inclement weather. Check OPS announcements before relying on either date as a day off.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Olathe Public Schools in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Seniors finish May 20, Early Childhood finishes May 24, and grades K–11 finish with a morning half day Tuesday, May 25, 2027. Grade 12 does not attend May 25.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Olathe high school finals in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Finals use regular high school hours December 16 and May 21. They use the 7:40–10:55 a.m. schedule December 17–18 and May 24–25.

calendarFaqs.q: How many days are in the Olathe 2026–27 reporting periods?
calendarFaqs.a: The official PDF lists 40, 42, 43 and 45 days, totaling 170 reporting-period days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the 2026–27 Elementary Specials calendar shift after a weather closure?
calendarFaqs.a: No. OPS states that the A/B/C/D schedule remains consistent across elementary buildings and is not affected by inclement weather.
